evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim using native domain vocabulary ('owned intelligence' / 'rented intelligence') rendered in plain, jargon-free syntax — the document's register signature crystallized in one line.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Same aphoristic-technical register: domain jargon ('substrate', 'commodity', 'asset') arranged as a matched opposition in plain syntax, reinforcing the document's signature register.

Self-referential naming of the document's own thesis in compound-jargon form signals the technical register, but the surrounding syntax is plain meta-commentary rather than a maxim — a weaker instantiation of the same signature.
